---
title: "Death at 26 weeks — supporting analysis"
subtitle: "Unadjusted Bayesian logistic model on completed 182-day vital status"
format: html
---

- Censored alive before day 182: death drawn from the QoL landmark vital-status model.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "posterior.R"))

qol_dir <- here("analysis", "03-quality-of-life")
results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "03-death-at-26-weeks", "results"
)
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)
n_draws <- config$posterior_draws$supporting
horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data
#| include: false

prepared <- read_parquet(file.path(qol_dir, "results", "prepared.parquet")) |>
  mutate(
    diagnosis_group = factor(
      diagnosis_group,
      levels = unique(diagnosis_group[order(diagnosis_code)])
    ),
    gender = factor(gender),
    age_scaled = scale(age)
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()

vital_status_model <- readRDS(
  file.path(
    qol_dir, "02-six-month-landmark", "results", "vital-status-model.rds"
  )
)

unresolved <- prepared$event_death == 0L &
  prepared$survival_time_days < horizon_days
```

## Completing 182-day vital status

```{r}
#| label: complete-vital-status
#| include: false

completed_datasets <- indices |>
  map(function(index) {
    death_182 <- prepared$event_death
    conditional_survival <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(prepared))

    if (any(unresolved)) {
      predicted_survival <- posterior_survfit(
        vital_status_model,
        newdata = prepared[unresolved, ],
        type = "surv",
        times = horizon_days,
        condition = TRUE,
        last_time = "survival_time_days",
        standardise = FALSE,
        extrapolate = FALSE,
        draws = 1L,
        seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 2600,
        return_matrix = TRUE
      )
      conditional_survival[unresolved] <- as.numeric(
        predicted_survival[[1L]][1L, ]
      )

      set.seed(config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 2700)
      death_182[unresolved] <- rbinom(
        n = sum(unresolved),
        size = 1L,
        prob = 1 - conditional_survival[unresolved]
      )
    }

    tibble(
      id = prepared$id,
      tx = prepared$tx,
      death_182 = death_182,
      conditional_survival = conditional_survival,
      imputation = index
    )
  })

saveRDS(
  completed_datasets,
  file.path(results_dir, "imputations.rds"),
  compress = "xz"
)
```

## Logistic models and pooled risks

```{r}
#| label: fit-and-pool
#| include: false

draws <- indices |>
  map(function(index) {
    model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
    if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
      model <- stan_glm(
        death_182 ~ tx,
        data = completed_datasets[[index]],
        family = binomial(),
        chains = 4L,
        iter = 1000L,
        warmup = 500L,
        cores = 4L,
        seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 2800
      )
      saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
    }
    posterior <- as.matrix(readRDS(model_path))

    set.seed(config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 2900)
    posterior <- posterior[
      sample.int(nrow(posterior), n_draws),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    intercept <- posterior[, "(Intercept)"]
    treatment <- posterior[, "tx"]

    tibble(
      draw = seq_len(n_draws),
      death_risk_usual_care = plogis(intercept),
      death_risk_ctdna = plogis(intercept + treatment),
      death_risk_difference = plogis(intercept + treatment) -
        plogis(intercept),
      imputation = index
    )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

risk_difference_summary <- draws$death_risk_difference |>
  summarize_posterior_draws() |>
  mutate(
    imputations = length(indices),
    posterior_draws_per_imputation = n_draws,
    computationally_reduced = TRUE
  )

write_parquet(
  draws,
  file.path(results_dir, "draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  risk_difference_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```
